scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1032 DXF writes containing six RENDERSETTINGS-family record profiles, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: Six generated records: base RENDERSETTINGS, RENDERENVIRONMENT, RENDERGLOBAL, RENDERENTRY, RapidRT preset, and extended MentalRay preset. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and verify caller payload/identity state, destination bytes, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus fresh typed readback of each record payload and allocated identity.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 122 and Binary 117 allocation offsets injected; caller/destination/identity rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for six AC1032 profiles does not establish producer-authored wire semantics or version-wide interoperability.
Other accepted RapidRT/MentalRay preset layouts, dictionary dependency closure, producer breadth and native rendering remain unqualified.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue P6-G's public-writer inventory with another exact uncovered route or version-specific compound-record variant.
